findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: propertycheck_catalogue, propertycheck_account · Private data: property_coverage, property_payment_options, property_report_one_off, property_report_card_checkout, property_report, propertycheck_lookup · Public sink: property_report_one_off.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: propertycheck_catalogue, propertycheck_account · Private data: property_coverage, property_payment_options, property_report_one_off, property_report_card_checkout, property_report, propertycheck_lookup · Public sink: property_report_one_off

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "propertycheck_lookup" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
